frequency_question: How often do announced or threatened union strike escalations proceed to an actual indefinite strike within a short-term window?
membership_rule: Includes multi-union coalition strike calls in the banking or major public utility sector with formal notice given; excludes localized single-branch or single-state wildcat strikes.
window: 19 days from notice or escalation point

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike (Nov 2022)

coverage_note: 5 major recorded instances identified in the recent decade for comparable banking union escalation cycles.
known_gaps: Minor regional union actions that did not reach national newswires are excluded.
validity_reason: Labor laws and union negotiation frameworks in the sector remain stable over a 2-year horizon.
